status: Review-driven exploratory follow-up, specified before the new runs; earlier DS2 exploration cannot be undone
scope: ML, validation and experimental controls only; no cryptography or quantum changes

grouped_validation.endpoint: Fixed round 30 pooled out-of-fold macro F1 on the 21 strict DS1 subjects, not a DS2 performance estimate
grouped_validation.selection: Compare three predefined candidates using DS1 only; DS2 is not evaluated or used by this validation stage
grouped_validation.training: Same FedAvg, one local epoch, batch 128, AdamW lr 0.001, weight decay 0.0001, 100 percent participation; training-only weights

matched_compute.sampling: 128 draws with replacement per local step; both arms use ceil(full-client-count/128) steps per round and full-reference client aggregation weights
matched_compute.primary_endpoint: Fixed final-round test macro F1; validation-selected endpoints secondary
matched_compute.interpretation: Unique example availability varies while gradient-step count, batch size, client weights, initialization and seed rules are held fixed

influence: Leave each of all 22 test patients out in turn as a sensitivity diagnostic only; no patient is removed from headline endpoints

subset_stability_amendment.status: Added after initial follow-up training started, before these six extra runs; not part of the original follow-up specification
subset_stability_amendment.reason: Independent reviewer requested variation of the fixed small training subset as well as training randomness
subset_stability_amendment.new_runs: Two additional small-subset draws crossed with three training seeds; original draw and full models reused
subset_stability_amendment.uncertainty: Crossed subset, training-seed and test-patient resampling; full models reused across subset draws
